promo: Exchange rates, gold, weather and prayer times in one app. Add beautiful widgets to your Home Screen and never miss a prayer with timely reminders.
desc:
KROV brings the things you check every day into one place: exchange rates, gold prices, weather and prayer times. No sign-up, no account.

MARKETS
• Buy and sell rates and daily change for the dollar, euro, pound and 60+ currencies against the Turkish lira
• A currency converter that shows what you actually get when buying or selling
• 1-month, 3-month and 1-year charts for your favourite currencies
• Gram, quarter, half, full and Republic gold; calculate the value of the gold you own
• Cryptocurrency prices

WEATHER
• Current conditions, feels-like temperature and chance of rain for your city
• Hourly and 7-day forecast

PRAYER TIMES
• Daily times (Diyanet method) with a countdown to the next prayer
• Nearby days, the next 7 days or the whole month
• Notifications you can turn on per prayer, at prayer time or 5–45 minutes before
• Suhoor and iftar reminders during Ramadan

WIDGETS
• Prayer: a sky that changes with the time of day, mosque silhouette, countdown and progress bar; also on the Lock Screen
• Weather: a background that follows the conditions, hourly and 5-day forecast
• Currency and gold
• Daily panel: prayer, weather and currency together

ALSO
• Recent earthquakes in Turkey and public holidays
• English, Turkish, Russian and Azerbaijani; follows your phone's language
• Light and dark mode follow your phone's setting

KROV is free and shows ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase turns them off.

Prices are for information only and are not investment advice.
